summary: Phase F5.6 backend testing — Auto-Sync presets for Blue Dart, DTDC, and ShipRocket. Created new pytest suite (20 tests, 100% pass) covering: /api/courier-sync/defaults for all 4 couriers (Blue Dart, DTDC, Shiprocket, India Post regression), unknown-courier matched=false, case-insensitive matching (bluedart/blue dart/BLUE DART/BlUe DaRt), Ship Rocket alias, auth gating (401 without bearer), end-to-end sync-test-parse for all 4 couriers with realistic SMS samples (Blue Dart 11-digit AWB, DTDC X12345678 pattern, ShipRocket 10-digit AWB, India Post EMxxxxxxxxxIN), and partner_slug_for_name unit tests (Blue Dart Express/BLUEDART/Blue-Dart → blue_dart, DTDC Plus → dtdc, Shiprocket X/Ship Rocket → shiprocket, unknown falls back to snake_case). All 13 review requirements verified.
critical_code_review_comments: DTDC tracking regex r'\b([A-Z]\d{8,10}|\d{9,11})\b' will also match Blue Dart-length numeric AWBs (11 digits). If both couriers coexist for a user, sender-pattern gate must disambiguate — currently OK because DTDC/BLUDRT senders differ, but worth documenting.
ShipRocket regex \d{10,15} may over-match long numeric substrings (phone numbers, order refs). Consider bounding to a tighter range once carrier-specific SMS samples are collected in production.
generic_parser.py is now 520 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting DEFAULT_CONFIGS into a separate presets.py module in the next iteration.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_-prefixed couriers (cleaned up via autouse fixture DELETE /api/couriers/{id}). No leaked data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: F5.6 preset additions are backward-compatible and fully tested. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_phase_f56_courier_presets.py for regression on any future courier_sync/generic_parser.py changes. It uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env; admin@test.com login fixture.
